title: A Friend for Life
text:
Maria and Lucia met at school when they were seven years old. At first, they did not talk much because they were shy. One day, Lucia shared her lunch with Maria, and they became good friends.

Today they are adults, but they still talk every week. They help each other when there are problems. Maria says that a true friend is someone who listens and stays close, even when life is busy.

questions.text: When did Maria and Lucia meet?
options: When they were seven years old
When they moved to a new city

questions.text: How often do Maria and Lucia talk today?
Why did Maria and Lucia not talk much at first?
options: They did not like each other
They were too busy with sports

questions.text: What can the reader conclude about Maria's idea of friendship?
options: Friends should only meet at school
Friends should listen and stay close when life is hard
Friends should always agree about everything
Friends should live in the same house

vocabulary.definition: feeling nervous about talking to other people
gave part of something to another person
pays attention to what someone says
having a lot of things to do

paragraph_translations: María y Lucía se conocieron en la escuela cuando tenían siete años. Al principio no hablaban mucho porque eran tímidas. Un día, Lucía compartió su almuerzo con María, y se hicieron buenas amigas.
Hoy son adultas, pero todavía hablan cada semana. Se ayudan cuando hay problemas. María dice que una verdadera amiga es alguien que escucha y se mantiene cerca, incluso cuando la vida está ocupada.
